notes: Descriptions derived from the .efx parameter values. 'slots' = which FX slots the effect can run in; time-based effects need slots 1-4. 'confidence' is 'low' where the parameter layout for that effect type is uncertain. 'source' is the input the preset was saved with (mix bus or insert); the slot rules still apply.

presets.name: Sound Stage
presets.description: Short, natural room ambience (about 1 s) with a large, diffuse space and a soft top end. Adds air and depth without an obvious reverb tail. A good general-purpose 'put it in a room' setting for a whole mix or a group.

presets.name: BBM #1 E7
presets.description: Stereo enhancer with bass, mid and high enhancement all turned up and extra output gain. Makes a source brighter, fuller and more forward. The name doesn't make the intended source clear.

presets.name: BBM 80s Nvr End
presets.description: Classic 1980s gated reverb: a big, dense burst cut off sharply after about 0.75 s, with the top end rolled off. Built for snare and toms; also works on electronic drums and percussive synth hits.

presets.name: BBM Ballad Snare
presets.description: Medium room, about 2 s, with a brighter tail and reduced low end. Gives a snare a longer, smoother ring for slower songs. Also suits sparse percussion or plucked synth sounds that need space without mud.

presets.name: BBM Cutting D6
presets.description: Dual exciter adding harmonics around 1.6 kHz and 2.75 kHz so a part cuts through the mix. The name points to the Hohner Clavinet D6, so it is meant for clav or other funky, percussive keys.

presets.name: BBM Dly Chr VOX
presets.description: Quarter-note delay (about 325 ms) with moderate repeats, plus a slow, fairly deep chorus. Widens and thickens a lead vocal with a clear echo. Works for lead synths too.

presets.name: BBM Fat Snare
presets.description: Short EMT-style plate (about 1.2 s) with a darker, shorter top end. Thickens a snare without washing it out. Also good on snappy drum-machine snares and claps.

presets.name: BBM Female Vox
presets.description: Smooth EMT-style plate, about 2.2 s, with 30 ms pre-delay and the lows cut. Sits behind a lead vocal without clouding it. Also suits pads and melodic leads that need a long, clean tail.

presets.name: BBM FLANGY AMB
presets.description: Slow, deep flanger feeding a very short, dark ambience. Gives a swirling, jet-like movement with a little space. Suits guitars, pads, drum loops and anything that wants a psychedelic sweep.

presets.name: BBM H949 Vox
presets.description: The Eventide H949 doubling trick: one side detuned 12 cents down, the other 12 cents up, short delays, panned hard left and right. Makes a mono source sound wide and double-tracked. Excellent on mono synths, leads and vocals.

presets.name: BBM Hwy Star B3
presets.description: Tube drive at maximum with a strong upper-mid boost around 1.9 kHz and some low-mid weight. A gritty, overdriven organ sound in the style of Jon Lord on 'Highway Star'. Works on organs, electric pianos and synths that need bite.

presets.name: BBM JJ Bass
presets.description: Very short delay with a slow, deep chorus. Thickens and widens a bass guitar, rather than adding an audible echo. Good on synth bass when you want movement, though it can soften the low end.

presets.name: BBM Magnum Opus
presets.description: Very slow, lush, wide chorus. Gives a broad, gently moving stereo image. Suits strings, pads, polysynths and electric pianos.

presets.name: BBM Miami Mod B3
presets.description: Leslie speaker simulation, set to the fast rotor. The classic Hammond organ swirl. Also works on electric pianos and string or pad sounds.

presets.name: BBM Ska GTR Echo
presets.description: Short, rhythmic echo with a fair amount of repeats and the top rolled off, plus a medium chamber. Gives the bouncing echo used on ska and reggae offbeat guitar. Also good on stabs, skanks and dub-style synth chords.

presets.name: BBM Solina Swirl
presets.description: Full-depth auto-panner (left and right in opposite phase) at about 1.4 Hz. Makes a sound move across the stereo field. Named after the ARP Solina string machine, so meant for string ensembles and pads.

presets.name: BBM Thk Cln GTR
presets.description: Short delay with repeats plus a slow, light chorus. Thickens a clean guitar and gives it a little shimmer. Works on clean synth plucks and arpeggios too.

presets.name: BBM Tight Plate
presets.description: Short plate (under 1 s) with a long 60 ms pre-delay, so the dry sound stays clear before the reverb arrives. Adds space and polish without length. Good on vocals, snare and fast-moving parts.

presets.name: BBM Tramp Whirly
presets.description: Light, slightly faster chorus with a wide stereo spread. Named after Supertramp's Wurlitzer ('whirly'), so meant for electric pianos. Also suits clean keys and bell-like synth sounds.

presets.name: BBM VOX Hall
presets.description: Compact hall, about 1.7 s, with a darker top and the lows cut. A smooth, controlled vocal reverb. Also a sensible default for leads and keys.

presets.name: BBM Wide VOX Tap
presets.description: Three-tap delay: a main 500 ms repeat in the centre, a shorter tap (3/8) hard left and a longer one (3/2) hard right, with moderate feedback and a dark top. Spreads a vocal or lead across the stereo field with a bouncing echo. Tempo-dependent, so set the time to the song.

presets.name: Dimension Z
presets.description: Gentle chorus into a medium chamber (about 1.5 s). Adds width and a soft space in one slot. Good on pads, electric pianos and clean guitar; the name nods to the Roland Dimension chorus.

presets.name: Danish Chor
presets.description: Deep, fairly quick chorus with short delays and full stereo spread. A strong, obvious 1980s chorus, likely named after TC Electronic's Danish chorus pedals. Good on clean guitar, fretless or synth bass, and thin synth patches that need thickening.

presets.name: Canyon
presets.description: Echo with 50% feedback feeding a very large chamber (about 2.5 s). Long, spacious, cinematic. Suits ambient leads, guitar swells and sparse synth lines.

presets.name: Memory Man
presets.description: Short 180 ms echo with 50% feedback and darkened repeats, in the style of the Electro-Harmonix Memory Man analogue delay. Warm slapback with a tail of fading repeats. Good on guitar, vocals and mono synth leads.

presets.name: Third Groove
presets.description: Three-tap delay at 400 ms with taps at 1.5x and 3x, panned left, centre and right, quiet and with little feedback. Creates a rhythmic, syncopated pattern across the stereo field. Tempo-dependent; good on percussion, arpeggios and plucks.

presets.name: Choriance
presets.description: Dark delay with 50% feedback plus a faster, noticeable chorus. A wobbly, lo-fi, tape-like texture. Good on keys, pads and guitar.

presets.name: Thing!
presets.description: Full-depth, high-feedback flanger plus a bright echo with 50% feedback. A dramatic jet-plane sweep with repeats. A special effect for builds, breakdowns and synth sweeps.

presets.name: Chordia
presets.description: Subtle detune: one side 5 cents down, the other 10 cents up, short delays, panned partly left and right. A gentler, narrower version of the H949 doubler. Thickens mono synths, leads and vocals without obvious width.

presets.name: Final Mix
presets.description: Light enhancement on both channels with a small output cut. Meant as a gentle polish on the main mix or a stereo bus.

presets.name: Floom
presets.description: Deep, slow flanger with strong negative feedback, giving a hollow, metallic sweep, into a small chamber. Good on pads, drum loops and guitars.

presets.name: ADA-Flanger
presets.description: Deep, slow flanger with strong negative feedback and a dark top, after the classic ADA flanger. A rich, hollow 1970s/80s sweep. Good on guitar, electric piano and synth pads.

presets.name: Phil's Drums
presets.description: Tight gated reverb, cut off after about 0.5 s, with the highs rolled off. The 'In the Air Tonight' drum sound associated with Phil Collins. Shorter and punchier than '80s Nvr End'; great on drum-machine toms and snares.

presets.name: Big Concert
presets.description: Large, warm concert hall, about 2.2 s, with 30 ms pre-delay and a soft top. A natural big-room sound for strings, pads, piano and orchestral parts.

presets.name: Squeezer
presets.description: Limiter with 6 dB of input gain, a fast attack, medium release and a -0.5 dB ceiling. Makes a bus or the main mix louder and denser. Use on the Main LR or a drum or synth bus.

presets.name: LFO Wah
presets.description: Resonant low-pass filter swept by a triangle LFO at about 1.6 Hz. An automatic, synth-style filter wobble. Good on clavinet, electric piano, guitar and static synth chords that need movement.

presets.name: Green Phaser
presets.description: Four-stage phaser at about 2.3 Hz with moderate depth and resonance, mixed in at about three-quarters. A classic pedal-style phaser swirl. Good on electric piano, string machines, pads and guitar.

presets.name: Vocal Plate
presets.description: Large plate, about 1.7 s, with 40 ms pre-delay and the lows cut. The standard bright, smooth vocal plate. Also good on snares, leads and keys.

presets.name: B3 Leslie
presets.description: Leslie speaker simulation set to the slow (chorale) rotor, with a faster fast speed than 'Miami Mod B3'. A gentle organ swirl that can switch to fast. Good on organ, electric piano and pads.

presets.name: Backwards
presets.description: Reverse reverb lasting about 1 s, darkened at the top, that swells up into each note. An eerie, sucked-in effect for vocals, snare hits, pads and ambient transitions.

presets.name: Punch
presets.description: Light enhancer with modest bass, mid and high lift and a small output cut. Adds a bit of weight and definition without obvious brightness. Good on drums, bass or a whole group.

presets.name: Crunch
presets.description: Guitar amp simulation with fairly high drive and the speaker cabinet on. A crunchy, mid-heavy overdrive. Meant for DI guitar, but also a quick way to give synths, organ or drum loops a gritty amp sound.

presets.name: The Voice
presets.description: Exciter tuned around 4.2 kHz, mixed in at about 30%. Adds presence and air to a vocal so it sits forward. Also useful on dull synth leads or pads that need clarity.

presets.name: A Step Back
presets.description: Stereo imager with a 4.5 dB low shelf around 300 Hz and a small output cut. Changes width and adds warmth, which tends to push a source back in the mix. Use on stereo keys, pads or a bus that sounds too forward.

presets.name: Punchito
presets.description: Moderate tube saturation with a slight lift at the lows and highs. Warmth and density rather than obvious distortion. Good on drum buses, bass, synths or a whole mix.

presets.name: TJ Fat Horns
presets.description: Light, wide chorus (the same settings as 'Tramp Whirly'), used by Terry 'TJ' Jackson to thicken a horn section. Also good on brass synths, electric pianos and clean keys.

presets.name: TJ Horn Verb&Dly
presets.description: A single, bright echo (very little feedback) blended with a short, large, bright chamber. Gives horns a sense of space and a slap without washing them out. Good on brass synths, stabs and leads.

presets.name: TJ Ping Pong
presets.description: Ping-pong delay with the main tap muted: one echo hard left at half the time (250 ms), one hard right at the full time (500 ms), no feedback. A clean left-then-right bounce. Tempo-dependent; good on vocals, leads and arpeggios.

presets.name: TJ Vox Plate
presets.description: Bright, short plate, about 1.4 s, with 56 ms pre-delay, the lows cut and 12 dB of extra output level. A sparkly, present vocal plate. Watch the level when you load it.

presets.name: Dyno Trem
presets.description: Tremolo at about 2.6 Hz with both sides in phase, so the volume pulses rather than pans. Named after the Dyno-My-Piano modified Rhodes, so meant for electric piano. Also good on organ, guitar and synth chords.

presets.name: Cathedral
presets.description: Very long reverb, about 4.5 s, with 40 ms pre-delay, extra low end and a darker top. A huge, slow cathedral tail. Good for ambient pads, choirs, drones and slow strings.

presets.name: Echo Hangar
presets.description: Very large, dark space, about 2.7 s, with the top end strongly damped. An industrial, warehouse-like reverb. Good on drums, percussion and dark synth textures.

presets.name: Drum Treat
presets.description: EMT-style plate, about 2.2 s, with vintage mode on, the rear listening position and a darker top. A slightly distant, characterful plate for a drum group. Also good on drum-machine buses.

presets.name: Stereorizer
presets.description: Transient shaper with opposite settings on each side: softer attack and longer sustain on the left, sharper attack and shorter sustain on the right. Makes a mono source sound subtly stereo through the difference in envelope. Good on mono drum machines, percussion and plucked synths.
